artifacts.summary: Documents the proposal-packet-vs-filing phrasing convention: a new subsection at Component 7 in multi-task-creation-standard.md, a pointer-only note in conclusion-stage.md's Overview, redeployed with RESULT=landed_verify_clean.

completion_data.completion_summary: Added a new Component 7-adjacent subsection to multi-task-creation-standard.md stating the forbidden/required phrasing shapes and the WHY, plus a two-sentence pointer in conclusion-stage.md's Overview deferring to it. Fixed an index-entries.json line_count drift triggered by the edit, redeployed (RESULT=landed_verify_clean), and confirmed both edits present in the deployed mirror.

sapience_notes.subject: conclusion-stage.md channel (b)/(c) execution
sapience_notes.value: The orchestration conclusion stage never files anything itself for channels (b) (agent-system changes) and (c) (follow-up tasks) -- it only aggregates and classifies evidence into the durable evidence store. Confirmed creation happens at a separate, deliberately-batched foreground invocation downstream. A task description or plan phase must describe this chain accurately rather than naming the conclusion stage as the filer.

sapience_notes.subject: Autonomous dispatch task-filing instructions
sapience_notes.value: A task description or plan phase must never instruct an autonomous research/plan/implement dispatch to itself file, create, or confirm creation of a follow-up task or agent-system change request -- AskUserQuestion is categorically withheld from dispatched subagents (docs/reference/standards/agent-frontmatter-standard.md's Tool Withholding section) and confirmation must execute in the foreground skill layer only. The correct instruction asks the dispatch to record issue-log entries (suggested_channel: follow_up_task | agent_system) plus a rendered candidate list, leaving confirmed creation to a foreground surface.

sapience_notes.subject: index-entries.json line_count drift
sapience_notes.value: Editing a context file tracked by a source-store index-entries.json entry (e.g. agent-system/extensions/core/index-entries.json's entry for contracts/conclusion-stage.md) trips Gate 3 doc-lint's line_count check immediately, before any deploy. generate-context-line-counts.sh --write refuses to run from the source store (deploy-root-guard.sh), so after any line-count-changing edit to a tracked context file, the index-entries.json line_count field must be hand-updated in the source store rather than regenerated.

sapience_notes.subject: git-commit-phase.sh Containment Self-Check and .claude/** paths
sapience_notes.value: git-commit-phase.sh's Containment Self-Check refuses to deposit any .claude/** path into a task's proposed_file_scope even when dropped from a phase commit, citing rules/source-store-deploy-boundary.md -- a deployed-tree path is never a legitimate file_scope member. Confirmed live: dropping .claude/context/contracts/conclusion-stage.md and .claude/docs/reference/standards/multi-task-creation-standard.md from a phase 3 commit (after deploy-headless.sh regenerated them) produced a WARNING for each but no proposed_file_scope deposit, unlike an in-scope source-store path drop which does deposit.
